notes.title: Fixed various bugs
notes.notes:
Added system voices

When the text is in "batch" view, it would move to the next text before all the lines were read out,
Fixed a problem where the voice would cut off in the middle of a sentence before all the lines were read.

Adjusted background music and sound effects.

Fixed a problem where the "batch" text cannot be selected by mouse operation.

Added display of safe data count
